info.title: Example bridge MQTT API
info.description: A sample AsyncAPI document for the theme's demo: an MQTT bridge's topics, requests and events.

broker.description: The MQTT broker the bridge connects to.

bridgeState.description: Whether the bridge is online. Retained; the broker publishes `offline` as the bridge's last will.

base.description: The base topic, `zigbee` unless `mqtt.base_topic` says otherwise.

deviceState.description: A device's current state: one property per attribute the bridge decodes.

device.description: The device's name if it has one, else its IEEE address as 0x and 16 lowercase hex digits.

deviceSet.description: Commands to a device: switch, set brightness and color temperature.

device.description: The device's name or IEEE address.

publishBridgeState.summary: The bridge publishes its state when it connects and stops.

publishDeviceState.summary: The bridge publishes a device's state whenever an attribute changes.

receiveDeviceSet.summary: The bridge subscribes to commands for every device.

payload.description: `online` while connected, `offline` after a clean stop or as the last will.

state.description: On/Off cluster: whether the device is on.

brightness.description: Level Control cluster: the current level.

linkquality.description: Link quality of the last frame, as the coordinator reported it.
